title: A colour swatch at the very top of the panel opens no picker
goal: Scroll the right hand panel so a colour row sits right at its top edge, then click the swatch: nothing opens. The same swatch opens the picker normally once the panel has been scrolled a little way down. Anyone whose panel has scrolled itself there clicks a colour and gets silence.
notes:
Reproduced 2026-09-22. Take Scripts/playtest/copy-own-color-walk.json, strip its three reveal steps, run Scripts/playtest.sh on it:

  [31 3-picker] the app's own colour picker opened on the colour this copy is wearing
  [33 press] FAILED: no control called "Related" in "Swatches" is in the panel; the ones that are: none.

The panel dump at that moment (panel-3-picker.json) holds the dock and nothing of the picker: Component section (a dock section header, out of window), Color (Fill) at window (1159, 892) in a 920 tall window, Edit Original, Detach, Appearance section... The press landed on the well and the popover never came up. Put a reveal of the Component section in front of the same press, so the well sits further down, and the same run lists Close (the picker), Save style (the picker), Shades/Related/Document/Recent (Swatches). That is the whole difference.

The well is ComponentPanel.swift:1965 (.playtestControl("Color", detail: property.name)) with a .popover(isPresented: editorState.colorWellBinding(wellKey), arrowEdge: .top) on it. Suspect the anchor view being clipped by the dock scroll view at the top edge, or the panel title overlaying the press point. Reached in the first place because a drop or an insert scrolls the dock down to the Library (the-panel-jumps-to-the-shelf-after-a-drop-instea), which is what leaves the Component section above the top and the Fill row jammed against it.

The three walks that hit it (copy-own-color-walk, copies-share-choice-walk) are green again with a reveal in front of each press; that is a walk working around this, not a fix.
acceptance: Clicking a colour swatch opens the picker wherever the swatch sits in the panel, including hard against the top edge
A walk presses a colour well with the panel scrolled to the top of it and reads the picker back out of the panel listing
The picker still appears beside the swatch rather than over it

log.note: Triage 2026-09-23: parked at p3. It serves interaction-foundations, which is staged next, and it does not block the video focus. Still a real broken control; it stays recorded here.
